preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.
The number of friends N must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each friend index i must be valid within the range of 0 to N-1.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == N for line in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must contain exactly N characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for line in stdout for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be either '0' or '1'.
